# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Verify the data against the original inspection report.
3. Edit each field to be more descriptive in nature with respect to the specific accessibility concern.
4. If any fields (other than the notes field) are marked as “incomplete” or “potentially not completed,” 
 edit the form fields as such but also fill out the notes field with the information contained in the original site assessment form.
5. If any fields need to be broken out into two or more accessibility concerns, utilize the notes field to convey the original and/or specific accessibility concerns or update the field description to the specific identified accessibility concern.
6. For inaccessible sidewalks, enter “sidewalk accessibility” as the “location.” Otherwise, enter the same wording used in the original site assessment on this form. 
7. Once the edits are finished, save the form and begin working on the next form, etc. Repeat until all records are updated.
8. Be
